title: School: The Borrowed Word and the Built One
label: ch:hi-skool-vidyalaya
canDo: I can name the school in both registers, say who is in it, and tell which of the two words belongs on a sign and which in a spoken sentence.

payoff.summary: Say where the teacher and the student are using the casual word, then read the sign that calls the same building by the formal one.
payoff.note: Closes HI-A1-LEX-23 (educational institutions), whose note recorded that school appears in four separate mock items across the two papers and was introduced nowhere. The track could already name the teacher (HI-C47), the student (HI-C47) and the act of studying (HI-C34) but not the building they share. Two retrieval lessons follow the two word lessons because atoms introduced at the end of a track have nowhere to be retrieved otherwise, which cost Spanish its attained level in chapter 420.
